models.name: PET-OMol-S (base)
models.recipe: Pretrained PET-OMol-S, no fine-tune. Program numbers (type-held-out gate, MD, permittivity) use the mlip.cpp GGUF export (fp32, ragged, no TF32); benchmark rows use the metatomic-torch checkpoint through ASE. These are two builds of one model, and the claims name the build.

models.name: Route B, Bq4m3_c01 (ORIG)
models.recipe: Amendment 23: Bq4m2_c01 plus the cluster-ladder training records; global total-charge conditioning, LES latent-charge Coulomb term (erf, sigma 2.5 A). Cut at step 12,000 of a 14,170-step cosine, no EMA, no IPR4 row weighting. One seed (13), H100.

models.name: C0 (seam control)
models.recipe: Amendment A29a control: from Bq4_K1, data4m3 (226,734 rows), IPR4 pair rows x4, batch 16, 12,000 steps cosine, EMA 0.999 with warm-up. Seed 13 on H100; seeds 13r (same-seed replicate), 14, 15, 16 on GH200 (A34). C0 differs from ORIG by EMA, IPR4 and the full anneal together.

models.name: P (seam band prior)
models.recipe: C0 recipe plus 32,760 oracle-labelled charged-pair rows (data5p; fixed ESP charges, not DFT; no Mg2+, Li+F-, Na+Cl- or K+Gdm+). Seeds as C0. W* of the A30 rule under the pairs-gate reading.

models.name: C0H (held lr, EMA 0.9995)
models.recipe: Amendment A35: C0 recipe with the lr held at 30 % of peak and EMA 0.9995 without warm-up. Seeds 13r, 14, 15, 16, GH200. The raw file is a non-annealed iterate.

models.name: A0 (N = 16 neighbours, from P)
models.recipe: Amendment A30 GO 1: init P seed-13 EMA, 16 attention neighbours, data5p, 6,000 steps, EMA 0.999. Seed 13 H100; 13r, 14, 15, 16 GH200.

models.name: A1 (N = 32 neighbours, from P)
models.recipe: A0 with 32 attention neighbours (training step x1.5). Seeds as A0. Each file is scored at its own N.

models.name: CEIL-A (no global Q, charges + potentials)
models.recipe: Amendment A36 ceiling arm: global total-charge embedding replaced by the Q = 0 row and frozen; energy tower fed local charges and smoothed potentials from a frozen 3-layer charge pass; otherwise C0 recipe. Seed 13 only, GH200 (screen).

models.name: CEIL-B (no global Q, charges only)
models.recipe: A36 arm B: as CEIL-A with local charges only. Seed 13 only (screen).

models.name: CEIL-C (control, global Q kept)
models.recipe: A36 control: CEIL-A features and init with the global Q embedding kept. Seed 13 only (screen).

models.name: AL (CEIL-A, 2x steps, 3x lr)
models.recipe: A36 arm AL: CEIL-A with peak lr 3e-5 and 24,000 steps. Seeds 13-16 (seeds 14-16 are the four-seed repeat of amendment A38). The 1-D scans use seed 13 only.

models.name: PAL (P's band-prior rows + AL recipe)
models.recipe: Amendment A39: P's data5p charged-pair rows with AL's Q-free ceiling tower, peak lr 3e-5 and 24,000 steps; seeds 13-16, GH200. Pre-registered 'adds up' reading: PAL within P's 4-seed spread on the NH4+Gdm+ 7.5 A overshoot and Gdm+Gdm+ LES-off dmin rms, within AL's spread on the Na+/Cl- ladder slopes, val500 upper 95 % <= 42.0 meV/A, ion shells <= 0.2 e.

models.name: Bq3 K1
models.recipe: Earlier route-B arm (section 5): global conditioning, conditioning force in training. Seed 13.

models.name: Bq4m3L
models.recipe: Amendment 26: Bq4m3_c01 with peak lr 3e-5 and 24,000 steps. Seed 13.

models.name: CTLc (control)
models.recipe: Matched control fine-tune of the route-B program, no long-range head. Seed 13.

models.name: SB K1 (local conditioning)
models.recipe: Bq3 setup with local conditioning and the conditioning force in training. Seed 13.

models.name: FC3b (frozen charges)
models.recipe: Frozen-charge arm (lrc = 1, padded path). Seed 13.

models.name: FTq (frozen charges)
models.recipe: Frozen-charge arm (lrc = 1, padded path). Seed 13.

models.name: RS (range-separated Coulomb)
models.recipe: Amendment 24: erf kernel times a C2 switch 6-9 A. Seed 13; open structures only.

models.name: HY (hybrid conditioning)
models.recipe: Amendment 25: global + gated local conditioning, g learned from 0. Seed 13.

models.name: HYo (hybrid, g0 = 0.5)
models.recipe: Amendment 28: HY with g initialised at 0.5 (g did not move). Seed 13.
